distributions.provenance: T2K:2015ujp — numu CCQE cross section per bound neutron on carbon, T2K INGRID on-axis Proton Module (scintillator CH; quoted per neutron) · flux-averaged CCQE at two mean neutrino energies, 0.93 GeV (low-energy region) and 1.94 GeV (high-energy region), combined one-track+two-track sample · MODEL-DEPENDENT: values are the T2K default relativistic Fermi gas (RFG) model (Table table_ccqe_result(a)); the paper also reports spectral-function and multi-nucleon (2p2h) variants that shift these values · CSV err = quadrature of stat and (upper) syst; exact asymmetric errors are 11.95 +/- 0.19(stat) +1.80/-1.49(syst) at 1.94 GeV and 10.64 +/- 0.37(stat) +2.03/-1.65(syst) at 0.93 GeV · transcribed from the paper
distributions.notes: Flux-averaged CCQE at two mean neutrino energies, 0.93 GeV (low-energy region) and 1.94 GeV (high-energy region), combined one-track+two-track sample. MODEL-DEPENDENT: values are the T2K default relativistic Fermi gas (RFG) model (Table table_ccqe_result(a)); the paper also reports spectral-function and multi-nucleon (2p2h) variants that shift these values. CSV err = quadrature of stat and (upper) syst; exact asymmetric errors are 11.95 +/- 0.19(stat) +1.80/-1.49(syst) at 1.94 GeV and 10.64 +/- 0.37(stat) +2.03/-1.65(syst) at 0.93 GeV.
